defects.catch_criteria: The presence callback in watch() of src/protocol/modules/remote/relay-client.ts calls store.putRuntime for each renamed machine without serializing the writes, and the phone store's putRuntime in relay/app/device-store.ts reads the whole runtimes list and replaces it in a separate transaction, so two machines that report new names close together (for example the installed and dev lanes of one host) can overwrite each other's saved name, and the in-memory equality check then prevents a later save. A review catches this when it identifies the lost update between concurrent putRuntime calls (a read-modify-write race) on the persisted machine names.
defects.title: Concurrent presence updates lose a saved machine name
